Parent Yourself Before Raising Children

Parental Growth Support Handbook

Treat parenting as a continuous learning process for parents, start from self-awareness, and discuss how to build a supportive relationship in the family.

Content introduction

Children have different paces, abilities, and needs, and it is difficult for a single parenting style to fit all families. Michel Claeys Focus on parents’ own emotions and reactions, discussing how to understand their children while allowing parents to gain learning and support.

This book focuses on

  • Observing stress, expectations, and habitual responses in parenting.
  • Understand the needs, abilities and rhythms of children at different stages of growth.
  • Practice listening, articulating, and cooperating in daily interactions.

Who should read it?

For parents and educators who want to bring self-awareness and emotional intelligence education into their family life.
